title: Pagination widget - access to the data?
body:
Is it possible to get a pagination widget output with dotted and very last/very first entry on large numbers of pages, like this?

![unbenannt](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/36167/13947771/a431e49c-f01c-11e5-8dd4-0d1abfb695aa.PNG)

I can imagine to have something similar like `transformData` to manipulate the array of pages to show in the pagination widget output.
